title: Ajax withdraws; a challenge between Zeus’ descendants
intro: Ajax is forced back. Tlepolemus challenges Sarpedon, contrasting him with his own father Heracles.

notes.text: “In the lower belly”; νείαιρα, lower; γαστήρ dat sg.
πήγνυμι, fix: unaugmented 3sg 2aor pass, “stuck fast.” δολιχόσκιος, long-shadowed, with ἔγχος.
δουπέω, fall with a thud: 3sg aor. ἐπιτρέχω, run up: 3sg 2aor, stem δραμ-.
“To strip the armour”; συλάω, fut act ptc nom sg, purpose.
χέω, pour: epic 3pl aor; “poured [spears] upon him”; δούρατα acc pl of δόρυ.
παμφανάω, shine brightly: uncontracted pres ptc acc neut pl with δούρατα.
σάκος, shield (neut): subject; ἀναδέχομαι, receive / catch: 3sg aor mid. πολλά = many spears.
“Planting his foot against [the corpse]”; λάξ, with the foot; προσβαίνω, root aor ptc nom sg.
σπάω, pull out: 3sg aor mid. δύναμαι, be able: 3sg aor mid.
ὦμος, shoulder: gen dual, separation; ἀφαιρέω, remove: 2aor mid inf, “strip from the shoulders.”
ἐπείγω, press hard: 3sg impf pass; βέλος, missile: dat pl, instrument / cause.
δείδω, fear: unaugmented 3sg aor. ἀμφίβασις, encompassing advance / encirclement: acc sg.
ἀγέρωχος, proud / high-spirited; gen pl with Τρώων.
ἐφίστημι, stand over / press upon: 3pl plup act, “stood threateningly nearby.”
“Great, mighty and noble though he was”; περ makes the ptc phrase concessive. ἴφθιμος, strong; ἀγαυός, illustrious.
ὠθέω, push: unaugmented 3pl aor; σφεῖς gen pl, “away from themselves.”
χάζομαι, give ground: aor mid ptc; πελεμίζω, shake / drive back: 3sg aor pass. Ajax reels back.
πονέομαι, toil / struggle: unaugmented 3pl impf mid. ὑσμίνη, battle: acc sg.
Ἡρακλεΐδης, son of Heracles: acc sg. ἠΰς, good / noble: acc sg, with Tlepolemus.
ὄρνυμι, rouse / drive: 3sg aor. ἀντίθεος, godlike; κραταιός, mighty. μοῖρα is the subject, Tlepolemus the object.
“Son and grandson”; Sarpedon is Zeus' son; Tlepolemus, Heracles' son, his grandson.
νεφεληγερέτης, cloud-gatherer: epic gen sg, with Διός.
βουληφόρος, counsellor: voc sg. “What need have you…?” τοι = σοι.
πτώσσω, cower: pres inf. ἀδαήμων, unskilled, + gen μάχης; φώς, man: dat sg; both in apposition to τοι.
“They lie when they say…”; pres mid ptc nom pl with the unnamed speakers; φημί 3pl pres, + acc and inf.
γόνος, offspring; αἰγίοχος, aegis-bearing: gen sg, with Διός.
ἐπιδεύομαι, fall short of: 2sg pres mid, uncontracted -εαι, + gen; πολλόν adv., “by far.”
ἐκγίγνομαι, descend from: 3pl 2aor mid. “In the time of earlier men”; ἐπί + gen, temporal.
“The might of Heracles,” periphrasis for Heracles himself; hence masculine ἀλλοῖον and apposition ἐμὸν πατέρα.
θρασυμέμνων, bold-hearted; θυμολέων, lion-hearted: acc masc sg.
ἕνεκα + gen, “for the sake of the horses”; κ becomes χ before the rough breathing after elision.
οἶος, alone / only: dat fem pl with νηυσί. παυρότερος, fewer: dat masc pl with ἀνδράσι.
ἐξαλαπάζω, sack: 3sg aor. χηρόω, empty / bereave: 3sg aor. ἀγυιά, street: acc pl.
ἀποφθινύθω, perish / waste away: 3pl pres; Sarpedon's men are dying while he allegedly hangs back.
ἄλκαρ, defence / protection (neut). εἰμί fut inf after ὀΐομαι; “I do not think you will be any protection for the Trojans.”
